setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 through a MIDI device: four trigs on steps 1 to 4 with C D E F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97. The sequencer is stopped. A MIDI controller on input port 1, channel 1 is connected and sends relative CC 20: a value of 63 means one step down and 65 one step up. Nothing is mapped yet and the velocity mask is Off (X).
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap K1, choose PARAMS, open Mosaic Midi Mapping and turn E2 to the selected-channel velocity parameter. The selected row reads Selected Ch. Velocity.
steps.title: Find the velocity mask parameter

steps.caption: Hold K1 and press K3 to switch from EDIT to MAP mode. The list now names each parameter by its id, sel_ch_vel for this one, and nothing is mapped yet.
steps.title: Switch to MAP mode

steps.caption: Press K3 to open the map editor. Learn is selected, and the editor lists cc 100, ch 1, dev 1 EMIDI, in 0 to 127, out -1.0 to 1.0, accum no and echo no.
steps.title: Open the map editor

steps.caption: Press K3 on Learn. The row reads LEARNING while the editor waits for the controller.
steps.title: Arm Learn

steps.caption: Move the controller so it sends CC 20. The editor learns it and the cc row reads 20, with input port 1 and channel 1.
steps.title: Move the controller

steps.caption: Turn E2 five clicks to the first number of the in row, Input low, and turn E3 one click right. It reads 1.
steps.title: Set Input low to 1

steps.caption: Turn E2 one click to the second number of the in row, Input high, and turn E3 left until it reads 2. Inputs 1 and 2 are the two steps a relative controller sends.
steps.title: Set Input high to 2

steps.caption: Turn E2 three clicks to accum, past the out row, and turn E3 one click right. Accum reads yes and out still reads -1.0 to 1.0, so each message adds to the value instead of setting it.
steps.title: Turn Accum on

steps.caption: Press K2 to assign. Back in the list, sel_ch_vel now shows 20:1:1, the controller's CC 20 on channel 1 of input port 1.
steps.title: Assign the map

steps.caption: Hold K1 and press K3 to return to EDIT mode, press K2 twice to leave the group, then tap K1 to return to Mosaic. The controller is now mapped to the velocity mask.
steps.title: Return to EDIT mode and leave PARAMS

steps.caption: Turn E1 to Channel tasks, choose Masks with E2 and press K3, then turn E2 to the Vel cell. It reads X, Off, because nothing has moved it yet.
steps.title: Open the Masks page

steps.caption: Send CC 20 with value 63 once, which leaves Off where it is, then value 65 five times: each message steps the velocity mask up one. The Vel cell rises from X to 4.
steps.title: Turn the controller up

steps.caption: Press Play and stop. The MIDI strip shows all four notes at velocity 4.
steps.title: Hear velocity 4

steps.caption: Send CC 20 with value 63 once more. The Vel cell drops to 3.
steps.title: Turn the controller down

steps.caption: Press Play and stop. The MIDI strip shows all four notes at velocity 3.
steps.title: Hear velocity 3
